scope: Offline image tooling/browser/app smoke only; no grade or full verifier run.
binding_limit: Image identity bound by host command; Dockerfile is excluded from /tests in image. Frozen Dockerfile hash alone does not prove exact image build provenance.

commands.stdout:
usage: rewardkit [-h] [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--output OUTPUT]
                 [--max-concurrent-programmatic MAX_CONCURRENT_PROGRAMMATIC]
                 [--max-concurrent-llm MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM]
                 [--max-concurrent-agent MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENT]
                 [--judge-env KEY=VALUE] [--judge MODEL_OR_AGENT]
                 [--model MODEL]
                 tests_dirs [tests_dirs ...]

Discover and run folder-based rewards.

positional arguments:
  tests_dirs            Path(s) to tests directory. Multiple dirs run
                        independently and are compared.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        Workspace path (default: /app)
  --output OUTPUT       Output JSON path (default: /logs/verifier/reward.json)
  --max-concurrent-programmatic MAX_CONCURRENT_PROGRAMMATIC, --mcprog MAX_CONCURRENT_PROGRAMMATIC, --mcp MAX_CONCURRENT_PROGRAMMATIC
                        Max programmatic rewards to run in parallel (0 =
                        unlimited, default: 8)
  --max-concurrent-llm MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM, --mcllm MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM, --mcl MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM
                        Max LLM judge calls to run in parallel (0 = unlimited,
                        default: 8)
  --max-concurrent-agent MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENT, --mcagent MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENT, --mca MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENT
                        Max agent judge calls to run in parallel (0 =
                        unlimited, default: 2)
  --judge-env KEY=VALUE, --je KEY=VALUE
                        Set an env var for the judge run (repeatable).
                        Overrides parent env.
  --judge MODEL_OR_AGENT, -j MODEL_OR_AGENT
                        Override the rubric's [judge].judge field. Equivalent
                        to setting REWARDKIT_JUDGE.
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
                        Override the rubric's [judge].model field (used when
                        the judge is an agent). Equivalent to setting
                        REWARDKIT_MODEL.
